what.text: This page follows refugees from Kazakhstan living in Russia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 112 Kazak refugees in Russia, 2.7% of all refugees from Kazakhstan.
The United States hosts the most Kazak refugees, followed by France, Germany and the United Kingdom.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Kazakhstan, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1996 and 1997.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 39787 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 40173, at the end of 1997, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Russia.
These are year-end totals for Russia only, reported to UNHCR.
